text:
Alyssa Parks: Hey @Chris — we need concrete on‑prem + marketplace cost inputs from VoltCloud for the cost model. Specifically: capacity buckets, reserved tiers (1/3/12 mo), spot eviction profile by region, billing proration rules, and one example invoice reconciliation that shows reserve credit applied. Can VoltCloud share a sample CSV and one worked example?

Chris Kovacs: On it. Quick Q: do you want hourly granularity or will daily be fine? Also confirm we want both soft and hard commitments documented.

Alyssa Parks: Hourly preferred, with per-slot id if possible. If not feasible hourly, daily with a 15m sample window is acceptable. Please include eviction_rate and expected replacement lead time. Also need an example invoice line showing how reserve credits are represented.

Mike Chen: For finance modeling, we also need price_per_gpu_hour for reserved vs spot, any marketplace listing fees, and how blended cost should be computed when a job spans reserved + spot. If VoltCloud reports buckets, include the slot counts per bucket and any ramp constraints.

Emma Singh: Also check whether there are separate rack/colocation pass-through fees for on‑prem, and whether marketplace billing is net of those or shown as separate line items. Small differences change our unit economics.

Chris Kovacs: Partner ops says they can produce the CSV but want our exact schema. Suggesting this minimal schema and a tiny sample — can we use this?

partner-bot: ```
slot_id,region,timestamp_iso,gpu_type,reserved_tier_mo,price_reserved_per_gpu_hour,price_spot_per_gpu_hour,eviction_prob,replacement_lead_minutes,commitment_window_start,commitment_window_end,listing_fee_usd,invoice_line_example
slot-0a1,us-west-2,2026-03-20T10:00:00Z,A100-80GB,12,2.50,0.85,0.002,45,2026-01-01,2026-12-31,0.15,"Reserve credit: -$150.00; Usage gross: $325.00; Net due: $175.00"
```

Chris Kovacs: example reconciliation calc (for modelers):

partner-bot: ```
# simple blended cost over billing period
reserved_hours = 1200
spot_hours = 300
reserved_rate = 2.50 # $/GPU-hr
spot_rate = 0.85
reserve_credit = 150.00 # dollars applied to invoice
blended_cost = reserved_hours * reserved_rate + spot_hours * spot_rate - reserve_credit
# blended_cost -> divide by (reserved_hours+spot_hours) for $/GPU-hr
```

Alyssa Parks: This looks good. Two asks before we close: 1) full CSV (hourly if available) by EOD; 2) explicit doc paragraph describing how reserve credits are calculated and when they hit the invoice (immediate vs monthly reconciliation). Also capture eviction SLAs per region.

Chris Kovacs: I'll escalate to VoltCloud partner lead and request hourly export + crediting note. Pinging them now and will drop the CSV to the shared drive. cc @partner-bot create ticket.

partner-bot: Ticket PC-4821 created: "VoltCloud — hourly capacity export + reserve crediting note requested". Owner: partner-ops. ETA: 48 hrs.

Alyssa Parks: Perfect, thanks. :thumbsup:
